hypothesis: Semantic outcome imbalance causes false rejections; paired trials isolate weighting from performance changes. Wording transfer and replay retention remain separate checks.

trials.name: control
trials.purpose: Match weighting trial throughput settings; preserve baseline sampling

trials.name: balanced
trials.purpose: Only per-record weights differ from control; replay stays one; total loss weight unchanged

trials.name: balanced-5e6
trials.conditional: If additional repair is needed or to check diminishing returns before selection

performance: Measure b4 checkpointing, b4 without checkpointing and b8 without checkpointing before updates. Preserve b4 and accumulation2 for the paired causal comparison.

selection.known_38_failures: Resolve all 38; exposed regression evidence only
selection.exposed_conditions: Complete fields and eligible semantic outcomes >=98% overall and each language; missing and disabled >=95% each language
selection.development: Fresh transfer >=95% on eligible, disabled and missing slices for each language; report complete fields and both polarities; retain each existing task within 2pp of instruction parent and old repaired candidate
selection.multi_task_regression: Each nonnumeric task within 2pp of direct parent and old repaired candidate; numeric >=old repaired candidate minus2pp and gate/missing>=95%; report predecessor changes separately because extraction loss predates this repair
selection.languages: Investigate task-language decline >5pp with entirely negative paired source-group interval
selection.stop: Select a passing candidate if the bounded higher-update comparison adds <0.5pp task macro and no material slice repair, or creates a tradeoff; do not optimize Jev gap. Amend prospectively if none pass; never use the new test to pick weights.

independent_test.opening: After weights, calibration and development selection freeze
independent_test.checks: Eligible, complete, disabled and missing >=95% each language; semantic balanced accuracy >=95%; retain parent complete and eligible within2pp; report group intervals and per-style outcomes

runtime: Merged export and full independent plus regression reload with zero changed decisions and <=1e-5 probability delta, followed by real HTTP and official SDK validation
